[Install]

outputs.tm/smb.conf:
# Ansible managed
# Minimal Samba configuration
# Share definitions go in /etc/samba/smb.conf.d/*.conf

[global]
    workgroup = WORKGROUP
    server string = Time Machine Backup Server

    # Include Time Machine share configuration
    # Note: Samba's include directive does not reliably expand globs on all distros,
    # so we include the specific snippet file.
    include = /etc/samba/smb.conf.d/timemachine.conf

    # Security settings
    security = user
    map to guest = never

    # Protocol settings
    server min protocol = SMB3

    # Performance settings
    socket options = TCP_NODELAY IPTOS_LOWDELAY
    use sendfile = yes

    # Disable printing
    load printers = no
    printing = bsd
    printcap name = /dev/null
    disable spoolss = yes

    # Logging
    log file = /var/log/samba/log.%m
    max log size = 1000
    logging = file
outputs.tm/smb-timemachine.conf:
# Ansible managed
# Time Machine share configuration
# Include this in smb.conf with: include = /etc/samba/smb.conf.d/timemachine.conf

[timemachine]
    comment = Time Machine Backups
    path = /fast/timemachine

    # Access control
    valid users = owned_tm
    read only = no
    browseable = yes

    # Permissions
    create mask = 0660
    directory mask = 0770
    force user = timemachine
    force group = timemachine

    # Time Machine specific settings (vfs_fruit)
    vfs objects = fruit streams_xattr
    fruit:time machine = yes
    fruit:time machine max size = 6T

    # Spotlight (disabled for Time Machine - not needed)
    spotlight = no
outputs.fruit:
# macOS/Time Machine compatibility (vfs_fruit)
   vfs objects = fruit streams_xattr
   fruit:metadata = stream
   fruit:model = MacSamba
   fruit:posix_rename = yes
   fruit:veto_appledouble = no
   fruit:nfs_aces = no
   fruit:wipe_intentionally_left_blank_rfork = yes
   fruit:delete_empty_adfiles = yes
